record.question: Episiotomy is best done:
record.explanation: Answer C: Mediolaterally. A mediolateral episiotomy is generally preferred over a midline incision where episiotomy is indicated because it reduces extension into the anal sphincter. Source/context note: Routine episiotomy is not recommended; use selectively and follow local guidance. Reference: https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789241550215. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
